proposal.summary: CVAT versions prior to 2.0.0 are affected by a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability; validation of URLs in the affected code path was added in 2.0.0 and users are advised to upgrade.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request a detailed technical report or PoC showing the SSRF attack path and impact (whether internal network access, data exfiltration, or request-triggered actions) and confirm affected endpoints; if confirmed, prepare an advisory with CVSS vector finalized and coordinate disclosure and updates.

evidence_quotes.quote: Versions prior to 2.0.0 were found to be subject to a Server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. Validation has been added to urls used in the affected code path in version 2.0.0.
Users are advised to upgrade. There are no known workarounds for this issue.
